description: South Korea unemployment benefit eligibility check: at least 180 insured days in the 18 months before leaving, an involuntary (or justified) reason for leaving, and being able and actively seeking work. Use unemployment-benefit for the amount.

ableAndSeeking.description: Able to work and actively looking for a job; default true

insuredDaysLast18Months.description: Paid days under employment insurance in the 18 months before separation (includes paid weekly holidays)

reason.description: Reason for leaving. voluntary_justified covers quitting for a legally recognized reason such as unpaid wages, workplace harassment or a commute over 3 hours

name: unemployment_eligibility
